supersedes: Visual acceptance only; it does not revoke J363_DE_AI_OVERHAUL source or asset-parity evidence.
required_actions: Correct header/content collision at 1440px, 768px and 390px using a shared header-height layout contract. Verify initial load at scrollY=0, keyboard focus and browser zoom 200%.
Remove blank visual controls. Each visible interactive control needs an accessible name and a visible purpose; decorative icons must not create a bordered, focusable or clickable square.

Complete the consumer-language pass on rendered public strings. Do not use technical approval labels such as DEAL XÁC MINH on the new surface. Preserve data fields for governance internally, but render user-facing category/benefit language.

For every rendered home catalog card, emit or link an existing stable evidence ID. If no evidence record is present, render a neutral pending state and suppress commercial/actionable wording. Do not manufacture, rewrite or promote evidence.

Correct the QA scanner so only actual interactive controls (button, input, select, textarea, anchor[href], or explicit role with keyboard support) count toward touch-target compliance. Record the raw list of controls and failures.

Create a new protected Preview, retain the current receipt as historical evidence, and write a new visual QA receipt. Include full-page and viewport-at-scrollY=0 screenshots at 1440, 768 and 390px; each must show header and first content section together. Include one screenshot of the fixed header after a scroll interaction.
Preserve canonical-to-mirror parity and leave J363 factual verified count, affiliate state and staging deals_feed.json unchanged.
acceptance: CEO will review the protected Preview and screenshots after the defects are corrected. Technical, visual, factual-content and release decisions remain separate.
